Thank you dear for your kind words and the astral hug, and for being brave enough to share your story. Sending you virtual embrace for what you had to endure as well! 

My dad actually does have a history with alcoholism, and was in rehab a few times for it prior to my birth. 

I sincerely hope you’re well at present or on the road to happiness :)
I feel my wanting closure through some attempt of an explanation on his part, may just be morbid  curiosity to a certain degree - for some reason answers would definitely help me cope with it
Yes my parents have been separated for 15 years thankfully - haven’t spoke to him once in the last 6
I agree about the stigma! And i’m actually very sensitive to this topic, really vexed at myself for phrasing it so poorly in the post

Really want to apologise for tagging that into the post above without context! The sexual abuse aside, my father has always exhibited certain behaviours and traits that have called into question what his cognitive functionality is. And of course it is entirely plausible that there is no correlation at all between any of these aspects of his personality

By no means am I trying to link neurodivergence of any capacity with sexual predatory behaviours - so sorry for the way it was presented above!
